answer: Payouts stay frozen at first. To earn, a key posts 1,200 POA in an umber vest book that yields nothing and cannot be sold. Each scored close adds a 70 POA line unlocking only after 20 closes; the unaged ember cannot be spent or pledged. Miss two freshness replies, or fail a zephyr-picked funding audit, and the book burns while the key is exiled 18 epochs. Honest start: 1,200 POA parked 20 closes. 1,000 fakes need 1.2 million POA idle that long plus a live reply each close, vs ~200 POA early exit. Trading vest books is the hole; each book is bound to one key, and co-funded books burn as a set.
